def solve(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find 3s block; output is 4x4? demo out 4x4 but input had 3-block 4x4 at rows2-5 cols7-10
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==bg and all(
        (a==b and g[a][b]!=bg or True) for a in range(max(i-h//2+1,0),min(i+h//2+1,h)) for b in range(max(j-w//2+1,0),min(j+w//2+1,w)))
    ]
    return bg,pts
